resources.string: End-to-end encryption is on for this device.
This server does not offer end-to-end encryption.
Encryption is not available right now. Check the connection or log in again.
The encryption keys of this device are lost. Reset encryption to keep chatting in encrypted chats.
Device key (compare it with the other screen when verifying; hold to copy)
The device list could not be loaded.
None of your other devices is verified. Verify this device with one of them: then it can share the keys of your earlier messages.
Reinstalled the app? The old installation stays in this list as a separate device until you log it out.
This device does not receive keys: its inbox on the server is full.
The device is signed out and its encryption keys are removed from the server. It will not receive new encrypted messages.
Key backup is on: the keys of your encrypted chats are stored on the server, encrypted with your recovery key.
No key backup on this device. Without it, a new device cannot read your earlier encrypted messages unless you verify it with another one.
The backup was replaced on another device. Enter your recovery key to use it here.
Replace the backup (keeps the recovery key)
Logs this device out. After you log in again it is a new device: restore your history with the recovery key or verify it with another device.
